 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajnish Bhatnagar
ORDER % 21.02.2023 Petitioner is the sister-in-law of complainant and is seeking anticipatory bail in case FIR No.226/2020 under Section 498A/406/34 IPC registered at Police Station Jamia Nagar.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is the sister-in-law of the complainant.
He further submitted that petitioner is a married lady and residing in Kolkata, and she is about 45 years old.

It is further submitted that petitioner has joined the investigation as and when required by the Investigating Officer and was granted interim protection on 29.09.2021 and since then there are no allegations against the petitioner of tampering with the evidence or trying to influence the prosecution witnesses.
On the other hand, learned APP submitted that though the petitioner has joined the investigation,
but she is bound by the notice under Section 41(A) Cr.P.C.
Keeping in view these circumstances and the fact that the petitioner has joined the investigation, the petition is allowed and in the event of arrest, petitioner be released on bail subject to her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.20,000/- with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer/IO/SHO of the concerned Police Station.
However, petitioner shall join the investigation as and when required by the Investigating Officer.
The petition stands disposed of accordingly.
